description.p: SquidServers makes creating, managing, and hosting local Minecraft servers effortless. Easily configure Vanilla, Paper, Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge servers with automated setup, performance metrics, and seamless world imports.

ul.li: One-click server creation with automatic Java runtime resolution
Real-time server performance metrics and RAM allocation controls
Automated player invite links and built-in network tunneling
Complete world backups, imports, and modpack management

screenshot.caption: SquidServers server dashboard and performance monitoring
Minecraft server configuration and setup wizard
Server overview with quick actions and connection address

ul.li: Simple Voice Chat Tunnels: Added Simple Voice Chat UDP tunnel support with automatic voicechat server property and local port synchronization.
Additional Tunnel Types: Added support for NetherNet, Raw TCP, and Raw TCP+UDP tunnels with updated Bedrock and Geyser networking.
Bedrock Default Transport: Set Bedrock tunnel transport to RakNet by default and restored direct UDP tunnel support.
Playit Quota & Account Management: Added tunnel quota tracking, agent key invalidation recovery, and account unlinking support.
Help Dialog: Added a context-aware help dialog accessible from the sidebar or keyboard shortcuts, featuring tailored guides and real-time status details.
Service Status Monitoring: Added real-time service health tracking for SquidServers and Playit.gg with global outage alerts and incident feeds.
Datacenter Status Visualization: Added state-aware color-coding for re-routed and offline datacenters in the help dialog.
Network Diagnostic Service: Added multi-host connectivity checks, DNS sinkhole detection, and an offline status banner.
Startup Error Panel: Added structured startup error diagnostics with error codes, log copying, and direct support actions.
Installation Wizard Reports: Added diagnostic Markdown report generation for server setup progress and installation errors to the log sharing tool.
Debug Identifiers: Added copyable debug identifiers (Install ID, Analytics ID, Account ID) in About settings and upgraded bundled Playit binaries to v1.2.0.
Player Management Bulk Actions: Added multi-selection and bulk actions (OP, whitelist, kick, ban) to the players dashboard.
Player List Refresh & Badge: Added manual online player list refresh via console query and an online player count badge in the sidebar navigation.
Startup Script Safeguards: Automatically handles interactive prompts in startup scripts and disables manual JVM/nogui overrides when custom scripts are active.
Server Search: Automatically displays a search bar when managing more than 8 servers.
Setup Wizard Mod & Plugin Drag-and-Drop: Added custom JAR file drag-and-drop to mod and plugin selection steps.
First-Launch Onboarding & Theme Selection: Added theme selection and initial setup flow to the first-launch modal.
Admin Notices & Policy Updates: Added admin notice banners and policy update modals with targeted dismissals and preferences sync.
Seasonal Themes & App Icons: Added Christmas seasonal theme styling, festive overlay effects, and dynamic app icon support.
Seasonal Server Icons: Automatically synchronizes seasonal branding for servers using the default icon.
Update Preferences: Added update channel preferences and an option to disable automatic updates.
Native Zip Extraction: Added native zip extraction using system tools before falling back to archive libraries for faster modpack decompression.
Download Reliability: Streamed large server downloads directly to disk with disabled timeouts to prevent corrupted or partial downloads.
PII Redaction: Improved regex patterns for IP address and Bedrock XUID masking in error logs and diagnostics.
Atomic Server Backups: Added atomic rolling backups and recovery fallback for server list storage.
Startup Script Detection: Recognized startserver as a valid launch script and ensured execute permissions on startup scripts.

description.p: Resource Pack Hosting, Custom Backup Schedules & Diagnostics Update

ul.li: Resource Pack Hosting: Added resource pack hosting, validation, and management in server gameplay settings for Java Edition servers.
Custom Backup Schedules: Added support for custom backup intervals alongside preset tiers.
Manual Update Check: Added a manual update check button in Settings with update commands for package manager installations (.deb, Snap, Flatpak, Homebrew).
Diagnostics & Error Tracking: Added short correlation IDs to failures and a local error history buffer for troubleshooting.
About Links: Added official website and donation links to the About section.
Memory Leak: Resolved memory leak caused by unclosed log stream loops.
Console Performance: Batched log updates and bounded buffers to maintain responsiveness during high log volume.
Analytics Reliability: Bounded telemetry queues and shortened network timeouts to avoid blocking actions.
Server Logs Tab: Added a dedicated Logs tab in the server dashboard with a log and crash report explorer.
Log Analysis Engine: Analyzes server logs to detect mod/plugin conflicts, missing dependencies, EULA issues, and port conflicts.
Log Sharing & Diagnostics: Added one-click server log sharing and an app diagnostics uploader.
MOTD Editor: Added an in-app MOTD editor.
Keyboard Shortcuts: Added keyboard shortcuts for navigation, server actions, and settings.
Smart Mod Disabling: Toggle mods on or off without deleting files, and upload mod JARs directly.
Scheduler Triggers: Added On Start and On Stop task triggers.
Linux Flatpak & ARM64 Support: Added Flatpak packaging, Linux ARM64 binaries (Playit and PortableMC), automated APT repository releases, and versioned SHA-256 permalinks.
Unsaved Changes Prompt: Added a warning dialog before leaving settings with unsaved changes.
server.properties Highlighting: Added syntax highlighting to the server properties dialog.
Playit Account Linking: Added Playit account link and unlink options in app settings profile tab.
World Gamemode Settings: Added gamemode dropdown and force-gamemode toggle to world creation and server settings.
